transport.port_setup: caller configures stty and PC physical-port rate; --baud only declares rate and selects bounded preview timer

packet.payload: canonical base64 of four-byte big-endian uncompressed length followed by zlib stream
packet.sha256: lowercase SHA256 of uncompressed compact JSON bytes

error.id: echo request id, empty for malformed requests

plan.duration_seconds: integer 1..40, capacity constrained by unchanged service

record_id: 32-hex session UUID/capture basename without extension; resolved only through validated registry
storage: volatile RAM, complete validated BIN+original .meta.json only, recovered across bridge restarts within the same RAM boot, no automatic deletion
analysis: full complete-record core analysis at original default FFT65536; display arrays may be peak-preserving decimated after analysis, with actual FFT/bin width/segment metadata and original bin counts retained
preview: 1Hz at115200;4Hz at460800/921600; latest-only validated original raw model summary, voltage/rpm gaps preserved, voltage-only FFT8192 computed on original contiguous raw samples, preview_only/not_classified diagnosis
backpressure: nonblocking stdout, bounded reliable queue, one replaceable queued preview; terminal events discard queued previews; queue overflow closes bridge and cancels its owned service
modes: production default; --test-fixture or --hardware-self-test explicit QA only; no shell execution, no arbitrary file API
